tool_limitations.limitation: No heuristic for a WinUI 3 Popup opened (IsOpen=true) without a XamlRoot; such a popup is a silent runtime no-op that builds cleanly, so the validator passed a dead calibration bar.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Add a WARN heuristic flagging .cs files that set Popup.IsOpen=true with no XamlRoot assignment (mirrors the existing background-task dead-control check).

special_apis.api: Windows.UI.Xaml.Controls.Primitives.Popup (overlay bar hosted in a UserControl)
special_apis.special_handling: In UWP a Popup auto-attaches to the current CoreWindow. In WinUI 3 a Popup not already in the live visual tree must have Popup.XamlRoot assigned before IsOpen=true renders; otherwise it silently never appears.

errors_encountered.error: Calibration bar banner never appears when 'Unreliable' selected (invokeOk=false, responded=false).
errors_encountered.root_cause: CalibrationBar is a UserControl instantiated via `new CalibrationBar()` and never added to any visual tree; its inner <Popup> has no XamlRoot, so CalibrationPopup.IsOpen=true is a no-op in WinUI 3.
errors_encountered.fix: Assign the Popup's XamlRoot (from the hosting element's XamlRoot or App.MainWindow.Content.XamlRoot) before setting IsOpen=true.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Migrated the Popup structure faithfully but the popup never displays at runtime; build is clean and no error surfaces.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: n/a (silent failure, not diagnosed during build)
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Skill documented XamlRoot for ContentDialog only; Popup (which has the identical requirement) was not covered, so the agent did not set XamlRoot on the Popup.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Not resolved during migration; caught only by parity scoring.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Adding a Popup+XamlRoot subsection to MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md and a validator WARN for Popup.IsOpen without XamlRoot.
